title: Viewing Party
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this episode, the office watches news coverage of the Scranton Strangler standoff while preparing for and attending a Glee viewing party at Gabe's apartment. Conflicts arise over TV volume and captions, and personal tensions surface, including Dwight's obligation to Angela conflicting with helping Pam and Jim, and Andy's sickness linked to accidentally eating powdered seahorses. Michael and others engage in humorous and supportive interactions, while Pam cares for her daughter Cece, who has a reverse sleep cycle. The episode ends with unresolved conflicts and uncertainties about character decisions and outcomes.
